project.name: LoL data web
project.summary: Chinese-language unified League esports data workspace: schedule discovery, per-game collection from ScoreGG, historical CSV migration, SQLite database, player/team analysis, a Vue website and daily sync; run locally with Python 3.12+ and Node 22+.

about.text: Chinese-language unified League esports data workspace: schedule discovery, per-game collection from ScoreGG, historical CSV migration, SQLite database, player/team analysis, a Vue website and daily sync; run locally with Python 3.12+ and Node 22+.

updates.text: README describes a daily sync that looks back 14 days by default.

data_sources.text: README: ScoreGG tournament list -> series -> game result IDs, raw JSON, validated and normalised into a local database.
